text: The well was TA'd in May 2016.  Sustained casing pressure was observed and confirmed in July 2016.  The pressure mitigation steps of drilling existing surface cement plugs and placing mechanical plugs cement retainers.

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 07/27/2025.

eWell recognizes a TA date of 10/24/2013 due to previous zonal isolation operations & prevents updating the date. This operation was to complete full TA through the surface plug

9-5/8", 13-3/8", and 20" casing strings cut/pulled BML. 48" drive pipe cut BML, but not yet pulled. Well status remains TAd.

The plugs in the well were set by a different operator (Seneca Resources Corporation) in 2003. Energy XXI doesn't have documentation for dates the plugs were set and tested.

All casings cut @ 26' BML.  After several failed attempts to pull casings, Management elected to  wait until platform removal to blow casings and remove with derrick barge.  Well A016 remains in TA status.

Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 51 A-4 well to produce the "CC-1" sand. The previous completion, the "C01" sand, was isolated by pulling the 3-1/2" tubing string at 12,080' MD, setting a CIBP in the casing at 12,075' MD, and dumping 50' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 12,025' MD. The "CC-1" sand was perforated at intervals 10,382'-10,392' MD. A CIBP was set at 10,399' MD and GP assy was set on top of CIBP. The "CC-1" sand was then gravel packed. Coil tubing was then utilized to perform an acid job on the well and jet the well with nitrogen to lift the well allowing for production to be established from the "CC-1" Sand. Operations began 03/25/2011 and ended 05/04/2011.

Top-Hole Operation 
The SA013 well will be a development production well, targeting the FR11 and FR14 sands drilled by the TOI Deepwater Pontus. The well is directional, with the surface hole location and bottom hole location both being in AC815.  The SA013 riserless section was executed with a deepening to follow November 2025.

Well was batch set (through the 22" casing) and suspended on 04/19/2012, pending further operations.
On 05/31/2012, tagged cement @ 8,694'. Apply 20k weight test down. Displaced well to 12.2 ppg mud with corrosion inhibitor. Install 30" TA Cap and inject McDermid fluid in TA Cap.

Wash sand with a coil tbg unit, install a thru-tbg gravel pack, wash proppant from atop the vented, gravel pack screen using a coil tbg unit and spotted acid into perforations to stimulate productivity.

Remington has completed drilling operations of the EC 269 Well No. 001BP01.  The open hole portion of the wellbore was logged and no hydrocarbons were discovered.  The well was plugged and abandoned for sidetrack operations.

The Well Status Date should be 06/28/2014; however eWell will not allow me to use this date since the previously submitted WAR for this well had the same status, and eWell will not allow a different status date unless the status also changes.

Operations to temporarily abandon the well through the surface plug were completed on 07/25/2025.

eWell recognizes a TA date of 07/19/2018 due to previous zonal isolation operations & prevents updating the date. This operation was to complete full TA through the surface plug

The approved APM was to change zones; however, after further geological review, it was determined that the new perfs were in the same zone, resulting in a modification to perforations in current zone.

The 9-5/8" casing has been cut & pulled a minimum of 15' BML. Remaining casings will be cut & pulled a minimum of 15' BML at platform removal. These abandonment operations were completed on 2/12/08.  SS207 Well No. A018 remains in TA status.

Operation objective was to fish 7/32" Braided line with Coil Tubing and Retrieve Packer and run a new packer.  The operation was unsuccessful in fishing the 7/32" braided line and retrieving the packer.  Operations took place from 4/6/2017 to 4/18/2017.

Slight intermittent bubbles were observed emanating from the annuli.   A slip on intervention well cap was installed. Micro-Matrix Cement was injected to stop bubbling. No bubbles observed.

Please note: The 30", 13 3/8" and 9 5/8" casings / conductors were cut at 186' AML.

Permit changed to zonal isolation in lieu of full TA. Complete 10/25/20

Due to issues on the E003 well, the decision has been made to demobilize all equipment and personnel and return in 2021 to complete the TA of this well. A new APM will be submitted to fully TA the well next year.

Stone has successfully completed operations on the EW 306 A-14ST1 well to convert the well from flowing to  a gas lift well. The previously installed gas lift valves were activated and utilized to produce the well via gas lift operations.   The results of the operations have reclassified the well from producing oil well (POW) to oil gas lift (OGL).  Operations began 08/23/11 and ended 08/25/11.

Operations to complete the temporary abandonment through surface were suspended; although the well is not abandoned to surface, all zones are isolated so the well remains in "TA Status" as of 01/29/2012.

Zone change operations were successfully completed on EW 306, Well A-3ST3.  Operations began on May 9, 2010 and were completed on May 25, 2010.  The previous producing interval, the "LH" Sand, perfs 16310' - 16328' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 16295' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug; ETOC @ 16245' MD.  The "LG Lwr" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 16167' - 16175' MD.

Additional TA work was performed on an already TA'ed well.  The only change from the previous TA is a 200' balanced cmt plug has added inside the 7" csg f/50' BML to 250' BML.  The "Well Status Date" does not change and remains 02/03/2006, the date when the well was initially TA'ed.  KOP is 7563' MD.
